attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Tennessee state income tax per hypothetical Form TN-1040. Tennessee uses progressive tax brackets: 2% on first $50,000, 4% on $50,000-$100,000, 6% above $100,000. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($6,000 Single, $12,000 MFJ), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.tn_tax = 0; add " Tennessee (no state income tax)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvi /result.tn_tax xdef " Tennessee (no state income tax)" job.audit_trail swap addto
initial_action.action_postfix: "TENNESSEE FORM TN-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.tn_agi xdef 0 /result.tn_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.tn_bracket_2_tax xdef 0 /result.tn_bracket_3_tax xdef
